ارتخيت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَخَيْتُ (irtaḵaytu) /ir.ta.xaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
# اِرْتَخَيْتَ (irtaḵayta) /ir.ta.xaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
# اِرْتَخَيْتِ (irtaḵayti) /ir.ta.xaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَخَى (irtaḵā)
